Final for Publication

3423 S Morgan St Type 1 Narrative

The applicant is seeking a Type 1 Zoning Map Amendment in order to convert the existing 2 unit
building to a 4-unit building. There will be no additions to the building, and the building will
follow all existing setbacks.

Proposed Zoning: RT4, Residential Two-Flat, Townhouse and Multi-Unit District
Lot Area: 6,500 Square Feet

Existing Number of Dwelling Units: 2 (Two)

Proposed Number of Dwelling Units: 4 (Four)

Proposed Floor Area Ratio:0.74

Proposed Off-street Parking: 4 (Four)

Proposed Setbacks: Existing

Proposed Building Height: Existing+
